Ak bola recenzia odmenená, táto skutočno: If a review was rewarded, that fact should be stated with the review so it is not misleading. The same goes for influencer collaborations and reviews given in exchange for a free product.
Ak predávate do iných krajín EÚ, rovnaké: If you sell to other EU countries, the same rules apply there too — the Omnibus directive has been transposed in every member state.
Ak recenzie neoverujete, nesmiete tvrdiť: If you do not verify reviews, you must not claim or imply that they are verified. That is a legitimate option too — you just have to state it truthfully.
Ak recenzie spracúva externý nástroj, id: If an external tool processes the reviews, it acts as a processor and the relationship must be covered by a data processing agreement.
Ak zákazník zanechá hodnotenie 1, 2 aleb: If a customer leaves a 1, 2 or 3 star rating, you are notified immediately and can open a private conversation to help them solve the problem.
Ak zbierate aj recenzie od návštevníkov: If you also collect reviews from visitors without an order or take ratings from other platforms, they should be visibly distinguished from verified ones — for example with a “verified review” label on those matched to a purchase.
